title: ONSure AI Product Currentness Composition v1
description: FR-META-057 AI Runtime Identity Closure / 34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md SS17 AI Currentness: 'AI Product CURRENT는 최소 다음 identity가 current여야 한다: model deployment, prompt bundle, tool registry, memory policy/backend, RAG stack, external provider contract, relevant validator qualification. 하나가 material drift이면 Product Composition currentness에 전파한다.' Reuses the same 6-state vocabulary as currentness-snapshot.v1.schema.json (a general product/deployment concept) but scopes composition to exactly the 7 AI-specific sub-identity axes SS17 names -- none of which currentness-snapshot.v1 itself tracks. overall_currentness is a computed field: it can only be CURRENT when every one of the 7 axes is independently CURRENT; any single non-CURRENT axis propagates to the whole, using an explicit disclosed severity cascade (REVOKED > INVALIDATED > STALE > REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED > UNKNOWN) since SS17 itself only states that drift propagates, not how mixed-severity axes resolve.
